<script type="text/javascript">
  $('#btn_cpnshipping').click(function(){
  	var pcount = $('#pcount').val();
	var iznos = $('#iznos').val();
	var brojracuna = $('#brojracuna').val();
      $.ajax({
            url: "index.php?route=extension/module/cpnshipping/import&token=<?php echo $token; ?>&order_id=<?php echo $order_id; ?>&pcount=" + pcount + "&iznos=" + iznos + "&brojracuna=" + brojracuna,
            type: 'post',
            success: function(json) {
                console.log(json);
                var div = document.getElementById('response');
                div.innerHTML = div.innerHTML + 'Etiketa poslana uspješno';
            },
            error: function(err) {
                var div = document.getElementById('response');
                div.innerHTML = div.innerHTML + 'Greška u slanju etikete';
            }
        });
    });
            
</script>
